pending_commit.commit_message: autotest: Remove video autotests that no longer monitored Remove video autotest tests that are not monitored and we decided not to port to Tast tests. The following tests will be deprecated by this change: * video_GlitchDetection * video_MultiplePlayback * video_VideoCorruption * video_VideoDecodeMemoryUsage * video_VideoReload * video_YouTubeHTML5 * video_YouTubeMseEme * video_YouTubePage Note that video_VideoDecodeMemoryUsage will be removed because this test's design is not suitable to monotor video stack's performance regressions. See http://crbug.com/988946#c3 for more details. BUG=chromium:953553 chromium:988946 TEST=emerge autotest-chrome Change-Id: I58318466b34aebf167e0816e290b8c45cfe3ef52 Signed-off-by: Keiichi Watanabe <keiichiw@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1717072 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org>
